description: The newest 40 'waiting on you' items, each with a proposed verdict. Nothing was closed or moved.

tip.text: **Of the newest 40 items "waiting on you", only 7 are real questions.** The rest are copies of those questions, or old waits whose agent has ended or whose work already landed. Nothing was closed or moved: every verdict below is a proposal for you. (85 items wait in all; these are the first two slices, newest first.)

tally.title: 📊 Tally: 7 real questions out of 40
tally.text:
❓ still waiting: 7 · 🔁 duplicate: 19 · 💤 stale: 12 · ✅ done: 2

Items 1–20: ❓ still waiting: 6 · 🔁 duplicate: 12 · 💤 stale: 1 · ✅ done: 1
Items 21–40: ❓ still waiting: 1 · 🔁 duplicate: 7 · 💤 stale: 11 · ✅ done: 1

The 7 questions, in one line each:
- Do you say yes to keeping one prompt refiner, built on Sonnet in ext/Refine, or do you want changes?
- Do you say yes to the mentions plan (three steps, about 9 dollars) or want changes?
- Do you say yes to the one item tool with three verbs (get, set, call), built in eight merges, or want changes?
- Do you say yes to folding LivePage into Page, starting with moving Item's file_url and load to the store?
- Should adding an item that another list already owns link to it as a Ref instead of moving it? The census says it is safe.
- Can you run the crash-dump command as admin once (about 2 minutes) so node crashes leave a dump?
- Trim Page.class.js from 755 lines toward 250 by moving Page's callers onto its helpers directly (step 3, about $6–8, touches many files)?

How it was judged: a Sonnet worker read each item's log and the repo as it is today ($1.31 for items 1–20, about $1 for 21–40). The mastermind judged items 1–5 on its own first and agreed on all 5, spot-checked items 32 and 35 the same way and agreed on both, and changed 4 labels (items 7, 17, 19, 33). Raw: [items 1–20](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-session-truth/audit-waiting/results.json), [items 21–40](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-session-truth/audit-waiting/slice2/results.json), [calibration](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-session-truth/audit-waiting/calibration.json), [spot-check](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-session-truth/audit-waiting/slice2/spotcheck.json).

why.title: 🔧 Why the list is so long (the system fixes)
why.text:
Five ways one question, or no question, ends up "waiting on you":

1. **A plan handed down waits twice:** once on the agent that wrote it, once on the agent that handed it down (items 1 and 2, 4 and 5, 6 and 16).
2. **An agent's whole session shows as waiting** whenever one of its tasks waits (items 16, 17, 19, 20, 33).
3. **One task is listed twice:** at its own folder and again at its parent's (items 9–11 repeat 12–14).
4. **A daily check-in re-posts a wait as a new question card** each day, so one waiting voice call shows up four times (items 21–24 and 26–29).
5. **A wait never ends when its agent does:** budget pauses from 10-17 (items 35–40), voice calls that ended on 11-03 (28, 29), merges that landed 17 days ago (7, 8).

The fix belongs in the "waiting" list's code, not in closing items by hand: count a wait once, at the task that holds it, and drop it when its agent has ended.
